prior_operator_result.scientific_consequence: next experiment targets capability formation/generalization rather than post-G90 retention

ARK_002B.finding: 4L/128w Micro reproduced memorize-first then delayed held-out generalization; fresh sustained G90 around 12k updates on seed47 while seed29 was still climbing at 18k
ARK_002B.use_in_CYR010: sets the 18k update scale-matched acquisition box and 200-update evaluation cadence

ARK_003.finding: simple curriculum and teacher/decomposition suffixes did not demonstrate faster G90; flat training was the only arm with meaningful OOD lift in the wall box
ARK_003.use_in_CYR010: primary acquisition stays flat; no teacher/curriculum arm consumes the session

ARK_015.finding: NARROW_HIGH failed 8/8 matched runs while NARROW_LOW and AUGMENTED_HIGH_REFERENCE failed 0/8
ARK_015.use_in_CYR010: if G90 appears with time remaining, run a small matched HIGH-vs-invariant-support rendering stress; this stress is exploratory only

ARK_016.finding: only one sealed-qualified recovery fork; no mechanism flag demonstrated
ARK_016.use_in_CYR010: do not spend this session on update-magnitude mechanism attribution

ARK_017.finding: no RESULT artifact exists at the audited head

data.holdout_note: STANDARD heldout axis is ordered first-operand tens band 6-7 versus train 1-5; commuted diagnostics are explicitly diagnostic because addition has commutative closure

primary_scientific_contract.question: does the real Cymek V5 4L/128w RESEARCH_SMALL proxy show a delayed memorize-to-heldout-generalization transition in the Arkenstone 9k-18k update regime?

hardware_resolution.preferred_rule: use RESEARCH_SMALL for 18k updates when predicted acquisition+evaluation fits the science wall
hardware_resolution.fallback_rule: if RESEARCH_SMALL does not fit, use TINY for a 36k-update long-dose diagnostic rather than fail Cell 0

reasoning_battery.STANDARD: frozen DEV_MEASUREMENT T2; primary held-out capability measure
reasoning_battery.COMMUTED: same held-out semantics with operands reversed; diagnostic only
reasoning_battery.LOCALITY: paired one-digit no-carry counterfactual interventions; exact output-delta relation + both-exact
reasoning_battery.RENDERING: unseen natural-language surface form; format robustness diagnostic
reasoning_battery.THREE_DIGIT: deterministic no-carry three-digit additions; length/compositional extrapolation diagnostic
reasoning_battery.digit_accuracy: tens/ones exact on two-digit STANDARD outputs

post_G90_stress.enabled_only_if: G90 confirmed and hardware-only remaining-time rule affords >=1200 steps per arm
post_G90_stress.SUPPORT_HIGH_1OF16: exactly one row in each 16-row batch rendered with operands commuted; semantic IDs unchanged
post_G90_stress.claim: exploratory single-parent invariance-support stress only; not a production gate and not an ARK-017 mechanism result

verdict_contract.G90_WITH_COUNTERFACTUAL_LOCALITY: sustained G90 plus final LOCALITY counterfactual relation consistency >= 0.80
verdict_contract.G90_WITHOUT_STRONG_LOCALITY_EVIDENCE: sustained G90 without the locality criterion
verdict_contract.NO_SUSTAINED_G90_IN_BOX: no sustained G90 by the fixed acquisition box
verdict_contract.research_claim_boundary: single-seed controlled-task development evidence; structural battery does not establish broad reasoning or AGI
